item.title: 5.0.5-beta.4
item.description:
ExtraDock 5.0.5-beta.4 – Version Access Recovery Beta! 🔐⬇️

This beta adds server-authoritative installed-version access while preserving compatibility with older clients and alternative license providers.

🧪 What We Need You To Test

  • Expired update windows: Confirm a version released after your included update period opens the dedicated recovery screen instead of the normal docks!
  • Eligible download: Confirm Download opens the exact newest ExtraDock DMG included with the license!
  • Renew and refresh: Confirm the website action opens correctly and a renewed license restores docks, shortcuts, and commands after Refresh!
  • Compatibility: Confirm eligible, lifetime, offline same-version, and alternative-license users continue working normally!

🚀 What's Next?

Once installed-version recovery passes the beta matrix across all Appit apps, it will be ready for the stable rollout!

Thank you for helping test ExtraDock 5! Your feedback drives every improvement we make. 💙

ExtraDock 5.0.4 – Docks That Stay Where You Put Them! 🖥️✨

Everything from the 5.0.4 beta rounds, now stable — plus two fresh fixes.

🐞 Bug Fixes

  • Quitting an app no longer freezes ExtraDock: Choosing Quit from a dock icon's menu could leave the dock and menu bar unresponsive if the app was slow to close — clicks would fall straight through to the desktop!
  • Two identical monitors are told apart: Two displays of the same make and model used to share one identity, so docks landed on the wrong panel — each screen now keeps its own assignment through sleep, wake, and replugging!
  • Keyboard shortcuts work with auto-hide: Using a shortcut on a dock set to hide automatically could lock it out of its edge reveal for good — the shortcut is now a temporary peek that hands control straight back!
  • DockFlow profiles play nice with auto-hide: Switching profiles no longer pins docks open, and restored docks stay revealable!
  • Live widgets grow instead of squeezing: Your 1–4 cell choice is a minimum now — a widget claims extra space whenever its visible tiles need it!
  • No more mystery red capsule: iPhone Mirroring and Handoff no longer get drawn as a stretched notification badge!

✨ Improvements

  • Better support logs: Saving diagnostics now captures the last five hours of activity instead of just the current session, so reporting a problem gets it fixed faster!
  • A proper app name: ExtraDock now shows its full name everywhere macOS asks for it!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
